title: Sablier on XDC
tagline: Sablier Lockup, Flow and Airdrops on XDC as event tables, indexed from a public RPC with no HyperSync. The Stream, Action and Campaign entities are not built here.

queries.title: Lockup streams created, per contract version and kind
queries.sql: SELECT 'v2.0 linear' AS kind, count(*) AS streams FROM lockup_v2_0__create_lockup_linear_stream UNION ALL SELECT 'v2.0 dynamic', count(*) FROM lockup_v2_0__create_lockup_dynamic_stream UNION ALL SELECT 'v2.0 tranched', count(*) FROM lockup_v2_0__create_lockup_tranched_stream UNION ALL SELECT 'v4.0 linear', count(*) FROM lockup_v4_0__create_lockup_linear_stream UNION ALL SELECT 'v4.0 dynamic', count(*) FROM lockup_v4_0__create_lockup_dynamic_stream UNION ALL SELECT 'v4.0 tranched', count(*) FROM lockup_v4_0__create_lockup_tranched_stream

queries.title: Most recent v2.0 linear streams
queries.sql: SELECT "streamId_dec", block_number, block_timestamp, tx_hash FROM lockup_v2_0__create_lockup_linear_stream ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 5

queries.title: Lockup withdrawals and cancels
queries.sql: SELECT 'withdraw' AS kind, count(*) AS n FROM lockup_v2_0__withdraw_from_lockup_stream UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel', count(*) FROM lockup_v2_0__cancel_lockup_stream

queries.title: Flow streams created, paused, voided
queries.sql: SELECT 'created' AS kind, count(*) AS n, min(block_timestamp) AS first_ts, max(block_timestamp) AS last_ts FROM flow_v1_1__create_flow_stream UNION ALL SELECT 'paused', count(*), min(block_timestamp), max(block_timestamp) FROM flow_v1_1__pause_flow_stream UNION ALL SELECT 'voided', count(*), min(block_timestamp), max(block_timestamp) FROM flow_v1_1__void_flow_stream

queries.title: Airdrop campaigns created by the v3.0 factories
queries.sql: SELECT 'instant' AS kind, count(*) AS campaigns FROM factory_merkle_instant_v3_0__create_merkle_instant UNION ALL SELECT 'linear', count(*) FROM factory_merkle_ll_v3_0__create_merkle_l_l UNION ALL SELECT 'tranched', count(*) FROM factory_merkle_lt_v3_0__create_merkle_l_t UNION ALL SELECT 'vca', count(*) FROM factory_merkle_vca_v3_0__create_merkle_v_c_a

prompts: List the Sablier Lockup streams created on XDC: a count per contract version (lockup_v2_0, lockup_v3_0, lockup_v4_0 create_lockup_* tables) and the 5 most recent streams with streamId_dec, block_timestamp and tx_hash. Use the _dec columns.

How many Flow streams were created on XDC, how many were paused, voided or refunded, and what are the first and last block_timestamp of any Flow event? Tables are flow_v1_1__*, flow_v2_0__*, flow_v3_0__*.

List every Sablier Airdrops campaign created on XDC (tables factory_merkle_*__create_* and merkle_factory_v1_3__create_*): campaign address, creation block and factory version. Which have emitted events in the merkle_* child tables?
What is the highest block this nest has indexed, and when was the newest Sablier event on XDC?
List every non-empty table in this nest with its row count and say in two sentences what the data is good for.
